name: Loki

moves.name: Mystic Bolt
moves.description: Green sorcerous blast thrown from the hand.

moves.name: Mirage
moves.description: Spawns up to three decoys with no mass or heat; each costs him -1 to attack while maintained.

moves.name: Borrowed Face
moves.description: Takes another's form over a full round; knows only what Loki knows.

moves.name: Whisper
moves.description: Telepathic suggestion that turns a weak-willed foe's next action; fails against strong wills.

moves.name: Enchanted Shackles
moves.description: Conjured chains that bind a foe for a round.

moves.name: Sidestep
moves.description: Swaps places with a decoy so the blow lands on nothing.

moves.name: Realm Step
moves.description: Teleports himself and nearby allies after a round of concentration; interrupted by damage.

moves.name: Transmute
moves.description: Turns a weapon, the floor or a wall into something inconvenient.

moves.name: Giant's Strike
moves.description: Asgardian-strength blow he throws only when cornered.

moves.name: Puppet Pawn
moves.description: Empowers a minion or dupe to fight in his place for the scene.

moves.name: Thunder Lure
moves.description: A prepared trap that turns a hero's own power against them; once per arc.

leitmotif: Sly chromatic waltz on a detuned lead with a mocking echo of Thor's fanfare; drops to a single sustained minor note when the smile goes.
